record.content: In Remind the SQLite FTS5 lexical index is a standalone virtual table kept in sync manually on every write via _upsert_fts_concept and _upsert_fts_episode, mirroring the existing vec0 embedding sync pattern. PostgreSQL (a STORED generated tsvector column) and MySQL (a FULLTEXT index) maintain themselves on write with no application hook. Gotcha: any new SQLite write path that bypasses those two helpers will silently drift the lexical index out of sync with the concepts and episodes tables, with no error.
